html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

A powerful threat capable of bringing immense despair approaches the Earth!

 

Here are the details for the September Update featuring the Annihilation theme.

 

New Uniforms have been added for Thanos, 
who is driven by his own deadly convictions, 
and Drax, the embodiment of vengeance who hunts him across the cosmos. 
Drax has also received his Tier-4 upgrade!

 

In addition, Tier-4 upgrades have arrived for Annihilus, 
the brutal lord of the Negative Zone and ruler of the destructive Insectoid Horde, 
as well as Galactus, the deadly cosmic entity who feeds on the life energy of planets.

 

Furthermore, a new Mythic difficulty arrives following Legend! 
A new World Boss, Annihilus, has been added, 
alongside J.A.R.V.I.S.—a brand-new team buff system 
designed to assist your heroes on the battlefield.
 
Please check below for more details on these and various other improvements designed 
to make your gameplay experience more convenient!

 

 

 

▣ Two New Heroes
 
Check out the abilities of Annihilus <Annihilation>, who seeks to destroy all life, 
and Galactus <Modern>, a massive cosmic entity representing overwhelming Power Cosmic.
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ Two New Uniforms
 
To celebrate the Annihilation update, 2 new Uniforms have been added. 
Check out the abilities for Thanos <Annihilation> and Drax <Annihilation>.
* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The two new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <September Update Celebration Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Annihilus and Galactus Tier-3 & Tier-4
​
① Annihilus
 
Annihilus has received a Tier-4 Striker Skill and Tier-3 Ultimate Skill. 
His mad obsession and destructive crusade for survival continue.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.
  

 

 

② Galactus
​
Galactus has received a Tier-4 Striker Skill and Tier-3 Ultimate Skill. 
As a law of the universe and a disaster incarnate, 
his power now turns toward his next planetary meal.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ Drax Tier-4
 
Drax has received a Tier-4 Striker Skill. 
To avenge his beloved family, he will swing his blades without hesitation.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ New Team Buff System <J.A.R.V.I.S.> 
 
The J.A.R.V.I.S. system has been added, 
allowing you to apply powerful buff effects to your entire team.
 
Craft your own combinations to adapt to various battle scenarios 
against increasingly powerful foes.
 
Key Features of J.A.R.V.I.S. are as follows:

 

① Applicable Contents: World Boss, Alliance Battle, Team Battle Arena, Otherworld Battle, Giant Boss Raid, Zombie Survival.
- On the Select Characters screen, you can equip the J.A.R.V.I.S. feature configured in your settings.

 

 

 

② Presets: 10 presets are available. 
Each preset can equip up to 3 Chips (1 Attack, 1 Defense, 1 Special).
- The same Chip can be equipped across different presets simultaneously.
  

 
③ Chip Types: Each chip possesses fixed options, with higher grades offering stronger stats.
* Where to Obtain: World Boss, Store.
* Grades: Ranges from 1★ to 6★ / 6★ EX (Premium). 
6★ EX (Premium) Chips grant 1 fixed option and 1 additional option based on set probabilities.
[Option List: Determined based on set probabilities]
Physical Attack, Energy Attack, Decrease Skill Cooldown, 
Physical Defense, Energy Defense, HP, Recovery Rate, Movement Speed, 
Decrease Debuff Duration, Attack Speed, Critical Rate, Critical Damage.
* For fixed options, there may be variations in stats even within the same grade.
* Unequipping chips does not cost any currency.
  
[J.A.R.V.I.S. Chip List]

 

 

④ Enhancement & Option Changing: Chips can be enhanced up to Level 10, which increase their fixed option and any additional options granted by set probabilities. 
The following materials are required:
- a. Data of the exact same grade and type as the target chip.
- b. Advanced / Normal J.A.R.V.I.S. Data Fragments (Not used for Option Changing).
* Obtaining duplicate chips automatically converts them into enhancement materials (Data) for that chip.
Example) Obtain 'Rare Defense Chip: Blast HP' (3★) 
→ Converted to 'Rare Defense Data: Blast HP' (3★).
* 1 Data item is consumed per enhancement. 
Required J.A.R.V.I.S. Data Fragment type and quantity vary depending on Star (★) grade.

 

 

⑤ Material Dismantling: You can dismantle Data converted from duplicate chips to acquire J.A.R.V.I.S. Data Fragments.
* Higher grade Data yields higher grades and quantities of J.A.R.V.I.S. Data Fragments upon dismantling.

 

 

 

▣ New World Boss: Mythic <Annihilus> & Other Improvements
​
Going beyond Ultimate and Legend difficulties, 
a new ‘Mythic’ difficulty has been added to challenge our Agents. 
Annihilus makes his debut as a new boss, 
and balance adjustments have been made to select Legend difficulties.
 
1. Mythic Difficulty - Annihilus Added
 
Stop the tyrant from the Negative Zone dimension and test your limits!
  

 - We need your strength to put an end to his relentless destruction!
 
① Annihilus can be challenged starting from Stage 1 after clearing the following unlock challenges:
- Unlock Conditions: Clear Dispatch Mission Stage 4-5, Own 3 or more Tier-4 heroes, Clear all World Boss Unlock Challenges
- Stages starting from multiples of 10 (Stage 10, 20, etc.) require completing specific challenges, such as including designated heroes, to unlock.
- Daily Entry Limit: Shares 5 daily entries with existing Ultimate/Legend/Legend+ difficulties.
- Today's World Boss is shared across Legend, Legend+, and Mythic difficulties.

 

 

* The type for World Boss Annihilus is scheduled to be changed from Universal to Blast.

 

② Annihilus's Conquer Level can reach up to Level 200.
Reaching higher levels rewards Odin's Blessing Chests, World Boss Conquer Chests (Mythic), Dimension Chests: C.T.P. (Mythic), Dimension Chests: Mighty C.T.P. (Mythic), and Tier-4 Growth Materials while enhancing Conquer Effects.
- Higher Conquer Levels increase basic damage dealt to Thanos & The Black Order.
- Conquer effects applied against Annihilus increase based on your Annihilus Conquer Level.

 

 

③ In this stage, you will face Annihilus, leader of the Annihilation Wave. 
Stop his attacks and earn rewards!

 

 

- Annihilus will unleash fierce attacks in an attempt to eradicate all life.
  
④ Various rewards can be earned upon clearing Annihilus.
- Obtainable C.T.P.s include Mighty C.T.P. of Energy, Regeneration, Destruction, Judgment, Authority, Greed, Refinement, and Insight.
- Starting from Stage 10, completing every 10th stage awards special World Boss Loot or Annihilus's Exclusive Artifact (Lord of the Negative Zone), or a J.A.R.V.I.S. Chip Chest (EX) as a First Clear Reward.

 

 

2. Other Improvements
 
Balance adjustments have been made to select existing World Boss (Legend) stages.

 

① Boss Skill Damage & Delay Adjustments (Knull, Dark Phoenix, Kang the Conqueror):
Lowered pierce damage and projectile counts to prevent unfair instant deaths, and added attacking windows when successfully dodging boss skills. 
 
② Forced Pattern Adjustments:
(Knull) 
- Improved the visibility of safe zones during special attacks after Phase 2. 

 

(Dark Phoenix) 
- Reduced the Phoenix Force gauge fill rate upon being hit by Phoenix Force attacks.

 

(Kang the Conqueror)
- Improved the visibility of Phase 1 special attacks to make it easier to dodge.
- Reduced the number of force field hits required in Phase 2 for faster pattern clearing.
- Lowered the HP threshold required to trigger "The Final Battle" in Phase 3.

 

③ Boss HP Adjustments (Dark Phoenix, Kang):
Boss HP reduced by 20%.
 

 

▣ New Artifacts
​
After the September update, Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Annihilus and Galactus will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 

- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. 

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, 
one as an Otherworld Battle reward, and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[September Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms featuring the Annihilation theme.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Update Hot Deals

 

Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 9/1 Maintenance - 9/29 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 9/1 Maintenance - 9/29 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- Find various update celebration products like Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack, and Hot Deal! Custom Gear Unequip Pack in the Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Shadowland: Challenge Mode has been improved.
① Training Mode Added: You can now replay previously cleared floors.

 

 

② Hero Entry Requirements Pop-up Added: View all owned/unowned heroes and their latest uniforms meeting the stage entry requirements at a glance.

 

 


③ Filter Improvements: The filter feature on the Select Characters screen has been improved.

 

④ Hero List Display Improvements: The list now displays only 'Available Heroes' instead of 'All Owned Heroes' on the Select Characters screen.

 

2. Batch Upgrade: Added Auto-Select feature to the Custom Gear and ISO-8 menus.
- Checking 'Upgrade/Enhance All → Auto Select' automatically selects up to 20 highest-grade gear owned for quick enhancement.

 

 

3. Biometrics: Enabled selling Biometrics/X-Genes for select heroes that were previously unsellable.
* Biometrics/X-Genes for unacquired heroes can be used as rank-up materials but cannot be sold.

 

4. Ranking: Added a Hero Search function when viewing C.T.P. and ISO-8 Set Bonus rankings, making it easier to quickly find a specific hero.

 

5. Event Quest Shop: Extended the availability period of the Event Shop even after the Event Quest ends.
- The list of tokens currently for sale is displayed at the top of the Event Quest Shop screen.
* Event Tokens can now be spent for +3 days after the quest period expires.

 

6. Removed forced notifications from the Challenges tab within the Pass UI.
- The daily notification popup (appearing once per day) has been removed.
- Applied Content: Weekly Pass, Special Pass, Prime Token Pass, etc.
 
7. Navigation: Updated the UI to display active indicators for content that has unclaimed rewards or hero/comic card selection options available.

 

 

[Target Content]
- Character Guided Quest (Power Up Mission)
- Tier-4 Character Upgrade Support
- Character Upgrade Support Event: Tier-4
- Character Upgrade Support Event: Tier-3 / Potential Transcendence
- Card Crafting Quest

 


▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. Fixed an issue in Guided Quest where selecting Tier-2 Venom caused an error pop-up.
- Added instructional text to clarify clear requirements.


2. Fixed an issue where canceling Gladiator's Ultimate Skill at a specific timing caused the visual effect to play without registering hits.

 


We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
